id: title:Gilbert09:drop leaked exception class name from sync errors

review.posthog_relevance: Customer-facing error message sanitization for warehouse ingestion failures, improving clarity and professionalism of error reporting.
review.reason: Adds a helper function to sanitize customer-facing error messages by stripping internal exception class names, replacing them with actual error messages. This improves the clarity and professionalism of warehouse ingestion failure reporting.
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include complete implementation or full workflow, though the helper and its usage are present; tier assigned based on the visible, bounded behavior rather than unverified systemic impact.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper function to sanitize customer-facing error messages, stripping internal exception class names.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents customers from seeing internal implementation details like 'RESTClientRetryableError' in warehouse import failure messages, replacing them with the actual error message. This improves the clarity and professionalism of error reporting for warehouse ingestion failures.
